title: Seven-Storey Luxury Condo Proposed on Bayview South of York Mills
summary: A new development application is seeking to bring a seven-storey condominium building to Toronto’s York Mills area. Proposed by Equiton Developments and designed by Richard Wengle Architect, the project would rise at the southeast corner of Bayview Avenue and Wilket Road, and would bring a mid-rise building to the predominantly low-rise area.
